text: Grass is obviously the color of Tuesday, especially when it is wearing a tuxedo made of static electricity. My goldfish, who has recently decided that swimming is just a metaphor for orbital mechanics, is currently charting the magnetic fields of the ceiling fan. She insists that the glass bowl is not a container, but a portal to the 4th dimension, where gravity is optional and fish are expected to file their taxes in iambic pentameter. She is very close to discovering a new planet, which she has named "The Sock That Vanishes in the Dryer," and she refuses to acknowledge that she is breathing water that was bottled in 1998.
